readings.GENERAL: all three registered worlds have outcome SUPPORT
readings.NOT_GENERAL: some world has P1 PASS, reached ENDPOINT, and has at least one model with per-model status EXCLUDE

annotations.ALL_EXCLUSION: >= 2 worlds at ENDPOINT and every endpoint world EXCLUSION
annotations.POSITIVE_EVERYWHERE: >= 1 world at ENDPOINT and every model of every endpoint world has Fraction(float(L)) - F_minus > 0

capture.CAPTURE_BELOW_HALF: some DEFINED model ratio has Fraction(float(rhoU)) < 1/2
capture.CAPTURE_AT_LEAST_HALF: every model of every endpoint world has a DEFINED ratio and Fraction(float(rhoL)) >= 1/2
capture.order: UNAVAILABLE, then BELOW_HALF, then AT_LEAST_HALF, else UNRESOLVED (OPEN-7)

similarity.world_mean_ratio: rho_bar_w = mean of the DEFINED model point ratios of world w; per draw rho_bar*_w[d] = mean over those models of rho*_wj[d]
similarity.central: ranks 125 / 4875 of each model's rho* draws
similarity.COMMON_FRACTION_COMPATIBLE: max over DEFINED models of central lower <= min over DEFINED models of central upper (6 to 9 models)
similarity.spread: S = max rho_bar - min rho_bar; paired draws: each endpoint world's rho_bar* draw vector permuted by np.random.Generator(np.random.PCG64(620640)).permutation(5000), one permutation per world drawn in worlds_order from one generator; S*[d] from the permuted vectors; bound = rank 4917 (OPEN-8)

error_statements.GENERAL: intersection-union; false-claim rate <= the largest per-world rate (<= 0.10 over three models)
error_statements.NOT_GENERAL: per-world EXCLUDE claims, three families at <= 0.10 each (union <= 0.30 nominal)

cross.inputs: the sha256-bound RESULT.json of every registered world; draws re-derived only for endpoint worlds

licences.SUPPORT: In world {world}, under its documented law, on {N} fresh histories, for each of three newly trained E4-recipe models, the gauged chart phase at resid_post_3 is not a function of the last four observations on its supported rows; it depends on earlier observations, aligned with the oracle belief residual, with a certified lower bound above the margin 0.01.
licences.GENERAL: This held in each of three new worlds chosen by an oracle-only spanning rule (Delta4_orc lower bounds 0.036 to 0.232), as it did in the stage-C world.
licences.EXCLUSION: In world {world}, whose oracle comparator is >= 3M, the three models' completion-protected beyond-four alignment is certified below the margin. It does not establish zero alignment or absence elsewhere in the representation.
licences.NOT_GENERAL: In {worlds} (P1 passed) the model(s) {models} have endpoint status EXCLUDE. Per-world EXCLUDE claims, three families at <= 0.10 each (union <= 0.30 nominal).
licences.MIXED_NOTE: A MIXED world without an EXCLUDE model is reported as MIXED and supports no NOT_GENERAL claim.
licences.GENERAL_UNAVAILABLE: No cross-world generality reading is available: {reasons}.
licences.CAPTURE_AT_LEAST_HALF: Each of the {n} models reaching ENDPOINT in {worlds} captured at least half of the oracle comparator on the same rows (nominal one-sided bounds). This reading makes no claim about {unavailable}.
licences.SIMILARITY: The observed capture estimates are {compatible} with a common fraction at the reported descriptive precision.
licences.POSITIVE_BELOW_MARGIN: a description, not a SUPPORT claim
licences.world_other_heads: tools/hwsc/CONTRACT.json licences[head] (stage-C templates) with {world} added to the fill

disclosure: HWSG follows K4b (EXCLUSION in w0, comparator below the margin), stage A (worlds by oracle criteria), stage B (pilot in w*) and stage C (SUPPORT 3/3 in w*). HWSG's worlds were chosen by a rule fixed before any HWSG data, from stage-A oracle records only; the planners knew stage C's result. HWSG's models, histories, charts and decisions are its own. No threshold, margin, chart parameter or recipe setting was changed in response to any earlier result; the capture floor 1/2 was set at planning.

ratio.n7_resolution: k4b_fresh.bootstrap_inputs builds the one-sided entry 'delta4_orc:all' (delta4_orc is not in k4b_cert.CONTROL_K)
ratio.defined_if: the world's B4-VAL gate PASS and the rank-84 value of the 'delta4_orc:all' draws > 0
ratio.rho_draws: rho*_wj[d] = draws['X:<j>:-'][d] / draws['delta4_orc:all'][d] (float64); rhoL = rank 84, rhoU = rank 4917 of rho*_wj (k4b_stats.bounds rank rule); the X+ ratio draws['X:<j>:+']/D and both central intervals (ranks 125/4875) are reported
ratio.nonpositive_draw: any draw with draws['delta4_orc:all'][d] <= 0 -> RATIO_UNRESOLVED for every model of the world (OPEN-11)
ratio.identity: re-derived L (rank 84 of X:<j>:- draws) and U (rank 4917 of X:<j>:+ draws) equal RESULT per_model L and U bitwise; else FAIL_TECHNICAL/NUMERICAL
